snippet.title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 1: Re-Raptored -- Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A triumphant return for the long-lost Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion franchise. Relive the story that started it all as Jack Briar, the legendary field agent who stopped the Bayliss Disaster.

This sequel remixes the original game providing a new story, a new soundtrack, and new puzzles. It will be available on September 23, 2025!

This game is produced as part of Strange Scaffold's new Project Share initiative, where code bases are shared with trusted studios to create spin-offs.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3830150/Creepy_Redneck_Dinosaur_Mansion_1_ReRaptored/
Our website: https://pedalboard.games/
